resumeText:
Ananya Reddy | Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh | ananya.reddy.cv@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering (AI and ML), Gayatri Vidya Institute of Engineering, Visakhapatnam (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.9/10

INTERNSHIP
Computer Vision Intern, Vizag Robotics Labs, Visakhapatnam (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 10 weeks)
- Trained a YOLOv8 model in PyTorch to detect helmets on construction site CCTV frames.
- Wrote Python scripts with OpenCV to extract frames from videos and resize them for labelling.
- Measured mAP, precision and recall on a held-out test set of 1,200 images and reported the results weekly.

PROJECTS
- Leaf disease classifier (final-year project): Fine-tuned a ResNet-50 convolutional neural network to classify 10 tomato leaf diseases with 94% test accuracy.
- Lane detection (academic, Image Processing course): Implemented Canny edge detection and Hough transform lane detection on dashcam video as part of the Image Processing course.
- Attendance by face recognition (personal): Built a face recognition attendance system for my class using face embeddings and a webcam.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Image Processing, Linear Algebra, Data Structures
- Deep Learning Specialization (online)

SKILLS
Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy, YOLO, CNNs, Linux (Ubuntu), Git, Google Colab

ACTIVITIES
- Paper presented at a national student conference on plant disease detection
- Robotics club member
